It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Count the number of lines, words, and characters in a file of any extension from current directory. file_name.description: Name of the file of current directory to perform wc operation on.

mode.description: Mode of operation ('l' for lines, 'w' for words, 'c' for characters).

count.description: The count of the number of lines, words, or characters in the file.

type.description: The type of unit we are counting. [Enum]: ["lines", "words", "characters"]
